name: timevoice
title: Timevoice
description: Start and stop Timevoice timers, see what's running, and log time without leaving the keyboard.
author: mahad_kalam

commands.name: start-timer
commands.title: Start Timer
commands.subtitle: Timevoice
commands.description: Start a timer, stopping the one that's running.

commands.name: running-timer
commands.title: Running Timer
commands.subtitle: Timevoice
commands.description: Show the running timer in the menu bar.

commands.name: recent-entries
commands.title: Recent Time Entries
commands.subtitle: Timevoice
commands.description: Browse the last two weeks of time entries, continue or stop them.

commands.name: add-entry
commands.title: Add Time Entry
commands.subtitle: Timevoice
commands.description: Log a finished block of time.

preferences.name: clientId
preferences.title: OAuth Client ID
preferences.description: Only for a self-hosted Timevoice: the client ID of a public OAuth application from Settings → Developer, with redirect URI https://raycast.com/redirect?packageName=Extension and the read and time_entries scopes.

preferences.name: workspaceId
preferences.title: Workspace ID
preferences.description: The ID in your Timevoice URL, such as k5nR8m in /k5nR8m/timer. Leave empty to use your first workspace.
